title: Indoor pools
content: I can’t help but wonder how or why I’m dreaming about indoor pools so often. My situation is especially baffling because I live in Hawaii. I live on an island. I’m not even sure we have any indoor pools here. I simply cannot understand what my subconscious or whatever would lead me to dream about indoor pools so often. As someone who swims in the ocean, and all of the hotels that we have access to have outdoor pools. I’m not sure how my imagination conjures up the indoor recreational indoor pools and hot tubs.? I mean, I’m sure we could say something like oh you feel free in the ocean, but truly you feel trapped, or some nonsense. But honestly, as someone who grew up on an island and has never spent any time in bizarre, recreational indoor pools and hot tubs, what the hell am I visiting in my sleep? Because it’s nothing I’ve ever seen before . Thoughts?
